notes.title: Mini-boss update!
notes.content:
To add some more variety to each run, there are now five different mini-bosses that can show up as you attempt to survive the night. 

Each mini-boss has its own unique attack patterns you'll have to contend with, from a cheering crowd that calls down weights of expectation, to a megaphone-headed office manager that assaults you with demands to work harder.

In addition to the mini-bosses, random events will now occur throughout each run, forcing you to adapt to new enemies and hazards.

Coupled with the recent introduction of Mosh Pit mode, this update should provide a fresh challenge to players who've already mastered the core gameplay loop.

I hope you enjoy this update, and please let me know if you have any feedback!

notes.title: Patch notes for 5th Jan
notes.content:
Increased max level cap to account for increased experience gain in Mosh Pit mode.

Fixed a bug with the permanent unlocks UI that didn't properly show fully upgraded tiers. Shout-out to Nate for spotting this issue!

notes.title: Mosh Pit Mode added!
notes.content:
For folks who've survived the night and want a tougher challenge, Mosh Pit mode increases the number of enemies, gives them more health, faster movement speed, and higher damage output. As a reward, you get three times as much sheet music from every drop.

Mosh Pit mode is unlocked as a toggle below the Start Game button once you've successfully survived a standard 20min run. There's also a new achievement for folks who manage to survive the night in Mosh Pit mode!

Along with the new mode, I've made some tweaks to the Guitar Lead and T-shirt Cannon weapons, buffing them to bring them more in-line with the other weapons.

notes.title: Tiny update for 3rd Jan
notes.content: Increased readability of both player and enemy bullets

notes.title: Tiny update for 1st Jan
notes.content: Moved sheet music drops from big enemies so that it's clear they drop both experience crystals and sheet music.

notes.title: Another tiny patch for 31st December
notes.content: Fixed a bug where ability cooldowns could not fully complete, preventing activation of the ability for the rest of the run.

notes.title: Tiny Patch for 31st December
notes.content: Small tweak to upgrade distribution to more evenly spread upgrades throughout each run.

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 29th
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where activating multiple abilities would break their cooldowns, preventing their continued use throughout a run.

Fixed a bug where achievements weren't popping.
